Previous experience within furniture, joinery, upholstery or a similar manufacturing environment would be particularly useful, but candidates with relevant dispatch or warehouse experience are encouraged to apply.

This is an opportunity to join a busy manufacturing environment in a role that offers variety and responsibility.

You'll also be part of a practical, team-focused environment where reliability, organisation and attention to detail are genuinely valued.
